description: BlackBerry is the leading wireless enterprise solution that allows users to stay connected with secure, wireless access to email, corporate data, phone, web and organizer features. BlackBerry is a totally integrated package that includes hardware, software and service, providing a complete end-to-end solution. The BlackBerry Enterprise Server Cryptographic Kernel is the software module that provides the core cryptographic functionality to the BlackBerry Enterprise Server.
